# Ser querido detenido · Arizona

> A free, ad-free, zero-tracking one-page tool in Spanish and English for people in Arizona who cannot reach someone and think ICE may have detained them. It boosts existing guides made by organizations (linked, not copied), links the official ICE locator and EOIR case tools, and lists Arizona phone numbers copied word for word from ICE and EOIR pages. It gives general information, not legal advice. Read on 2026-11-27.

## What it is
- Guide 1, Freedom for Immigrants: resources for people facing detention, their families and loved ones (Spanish and English, nationwide, no date shown): finding someone, court date, finding a lawyer, bond, sending money.
- Guide 2, Florence Project (Arizona): "What if I'm Picked up by ICE in Arizona? Making a Family Plan" (Spanish and English, marked 2017), for parents.
- Guide 3, Women's Refugee Commission: "Detained or Deported: What About My Children?" (Spanish and English PDF, March 2025), for parents.
- Official tools: ICE Online Detainee Locator, EOIR Automated Case Information (Spanish and English), EOIR case status page.
- Arizona phone numbers (ICE Phoenix, Eloy, Florence, EOIR case line, Florence Project) with the official text they come from.

## Who it is for
- Family members and friends of a person detained by ICE in Arizona, and the people who help them.

## How to use it
- Open the page, pick Spanish or English, open a guide. It works without JavaScript, stores nothing and has no analytics. The English view is the same page at ?lang=en.

## Key links
- Page: https://brianallengit.github.io/ser-querido-detenido-az/
- English view: https://brianallengit.github.io/ser-querido-detenido-az/?lang=en

## Sources

- Freedom for Immigrants (Spanish): https://www.freedomforimmigrants.org/recursos
- Florence Project family plan (English page): https://firrp.org/resources/prose/parentalrights/
- Florence Project family plan (Spanish page): https://firrp.org/es/resources/prose/parentalrights/
- Women's Refugee Commission toolkit page: https://www.womensrefugeecommission.org/research-resources/detained-or-deported-parental-toolkit-english-interactive/

- EOIR Automated Case Information (Spanish): https://acis.eoir.justice.gov/es/
- EOIR Check Case Status: https://www.justice.gov/eoir/check-case-status
- EOIR List of Pro Bono Legal Service Providers: https://www.justice.gov/eoir/list-pro-bono-legal-service-providers

## Limits
- Not legal advice. None of the three guides says a lawyer reviewed it. The Florence Project guide is marked 2017, so its rules may have changed. ICE's locator itself could not be opened by our tool, so its screens were not read. Talk to a lawyer or a legal aid group about your own case.
